## Sufficiency changes as inquiry changes the situation

The [sufficiency continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-SUFFICIENCY-INTEGRATION.md) derives a concrete relation from a saved actual method history. After readings `010`, two candidate models both predict the next reading zero. That action/read occurs and removes neither candidate, but advances both cursors. The newly next reading now has different predictions. The earlier answer remains correct; its applicability has changed with the situation.

This is more precise than equating sufficient inquiry with a small candidate set. Different models may already settle one question while disagreeing about another. A separate exact-budget endpoint retains a correct model yet cannot start another native command under its unchanged resource law. Settled content, horizon and feasible continued activity must be represented together.

The [conditional mathematical composition](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-SUFFICIENCY-MATH.md) propagates each compatible configuration through inquiry, then branches on the acquired observation and tests common responses at the resulting configurations. It is a standard bounded contingent-policy criterion built from existing results; no native controller or criterion acquisition is thereby installed. Its requirements, interface and implementation remain explicit obligations.

One-step agreement also does not meet the original method learner's stronger all-future prediction contract. This analysis preserves that task and its counterexamples. The further connection is effects of inquiry on relevant continuing activity → acquired revision of which unresolved distinctions require more inquiry. That relation must form and govern actual activity, rather than being supplied as a new favorable score. Concern and governance additionally require their substantive grounds and differentiated consequences.
